name: Artificial-life core
rulesStatus: provisional source lifecycle; output, reserve size and replenishment rates are playtest candidates
description: A self-sustaining artificial-life core. Provides its authored simultaneous output without consuming per-step fuel; does not waive construction, mass, power, connection, or shutdown limits.

name: Solar/rechargeable crystal
rulesStatus: provisional source lifecycle; output, reserve size and replenishment rates are playtest candidates
description: Stores solar charge. Active output consumes a finite charge each operating step; an externally verified sunlight-exposure event can replenish the reservoir within capacity.

name: Soul gem
rulesStatus: provisional source lifecycle; output, reserve size and replenishment rates are playtest candidates
description: Draws on a finite store of bound soul energy. Depletion shuts off output; restoring charge requires a separately authorized soul-energy acquisition or binding event.

name: Infernal Engine
rulesStatus: provisional source lifecycle; output, reserve size and replenishment rates are playtest candidates
description: Consumes a finite supply of infernal fuel to produce its authored output. An authenticated infernal-fuel offering replenishes its reservoir, and depletion suppresses output.

name: Arcane-consuming core
rulesStatus: provisional source lifecycle; output, reserve size and replenishment rates are playtest candidates
description: Consumes a finite store of absorbed arcane energy. An independently authorized arcane-energy expenditure can replenish its reservoir; no spell slot or item is spent automatically.

name: Mechanical engine
rulesStatus: provisional source lifecycle; output, reserve size and replenishment rates are playtest candidates
description: Produces eight simultaneous power units. Per-step operation has no separate finite charge meter; one ordinary mechanical-fuel charge replaces a daily food ration, with standard survival consequences for missed sustenance.
